# Setup

```{r}
# Working directory should be the root directory of repository.
# setwd("./")
renv::load()
source("./results/utils.R")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  # devtools::load_all("~/gits/ClemensKohl/CAdir/")
  library(CAdir)

  library(SingleCellExperiment)

})

options(repr.plot.width = 20, repr.plot.height = 15)
set.seed(2358)
dir <- "./results/"
imgdir <- file.path(dir, "img/review2/n_rnd_iters/")

```

```{r}
data_dir <- file.path(
  "./data/real/preprocessed/benchmarking/"
)
files <- list.files(path = data_dir, pattern = "*.rds", full.names = TRUE)
```

```{r}
iters <- seq.int(0, 1000, by = 10)
# iters <- seq.int(0, 30, by = 10)
iters[1] <- 1

files_list <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(files))

options(rlib_message_verbosity = "quiet")
for (i in seq_len(length(files))) {
  rnd_vec <- vector(mode = "numeric", length = length(iters))
  rnd_ari_vec <- vector(mode = "numeric", length = length(iters))
  n_it <- vector(mode = "character", length = length(iters))
  f <- files[i]
  fnm <- gsub("_filtered.rds", "", basename(f))
  fnm <- gsub(".rds", "", fnm)
  cat("\n", fnm)

  sce <- readRDS(f)

  if (fnm == "tabula_muris_sub") {
    sce$truth <- sce$cell_ontology_class
  }

  set.seed(1234)
  sce_var <- scran::modelGeneVar(sce)
  sce_top <- scran::getTopHVGs(sce_var, n = 2000, var.threshold = NULL) #1000
  sce <- sce[sce_top, ]
  cnts <- as.matrix(logcounts(sce))

  ca <- cacomp(
    obj = cnts,
    princ_coords = 3,
    dims = 30, #20
    top = nrow(cnts),
    residuals = "pearson",
    clip = TRUE
  )

  cadir <- dirclust_splitmerge(
    caobj = ca,
    k = 10,
    cutoff = NULL,
    method = "random",
    apl_quant = 0.99
  )

  for (j in seq_along(iters)) {
    n <- iters[j]
    cat("\n\titer", n)

    rnd_cutoff <- CAdir:::get_apl_cutoff(
      caobj = ca,
      method = "random",
      group = which(cadir@cell_clusters == "cluster_1"),
      counts = NULL,
      quant = 0.99,
      apl_cutoff_reps = n,
      axis = "cols"
    )

    rnd_ang <- CAdir:::rad2deg(rnd_cutoff)

    cadir_rnd <- dirclust_splitmerge(
      caobj = ca,
      k = 10,
      cutoff = rnd_ang,
      apl_quant = 0.99
    )

    sce$cadir_rnd <- cadir_rnd@cell_clusters
    ari_rnd <- aricode::clustComp(sce$cadir_rnd, sce$truth)$ARI

    rnd_vec[j] <- rnd_ang
    names(rnd_vec)[j] <- fnm

    rnd_ari_vec[j] <- ari_rnd
    names(rnd_ari_vec)[j] <- fnm

    n_it[j] <- n
  }

  files_list[[i]] <- data.frame(
    n_iters = n_it,
    dataset = fnm,
    cutoff_angle = rnd_vec,
    ARI = rnd_ari_vec
  )
}
saveRDS(files_list, file = file.path(resdir, "files_list.rds"))
```

```{r}
df <- do.call(rbind, files_list)
# df <- df[!is.na(df$dataset) & df$dataset != "", ]

p_ari <- ggplot(
  df,
  aes(x = n_iters, y = ARI, color = dataset, group = dataset)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  CAdir::scale_color_mpimg() +
  labs(
    title = "Effect of number of random directions on ARI",
    x = "nr. random iterations",
    y = "ARI",
    color = "Dataset"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

p_ang <- ggplot(
  df,
  aes(x = n_iters, y = cutoff_angle, color = dataset, group = dataset)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  CAdir::scale_color_mpimg() +
  labs(
    title = "Effect of number of random directions on cutoff angle",
    x = "nr. random iterations",
    y = "angle [degrees]",
    color = "Dataset"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

```{r}

  p_ari +
```
